title: Project OS v2 resolver_output family contract
description: Durable ResolverOutput contract family. Payload reuses resolver_output.v1 and may carry reference-only fields: allowed_output_contract_ref, output_template_ref, response_shape_ref, selected_plantilla_refs, selected_artefacto_refs, selected_variable_refs, selected_contrato_refs. These are metadata refs only and do not store rendered content, generated bodies, live runtime values, commands, permissions, or write authorization.
